declarations.rationale: President possessive/of paths dominate (18 plus relative-president); managerial employment and coaching are excluded.
Senate/country leader-appositive and leader-said constructions dominate, inverse body-to-named-leader; spokesperson-to-leader attachment is a boundary.
Known-as/by-acronym/initials paths dominate, with organization-to-acronym roles.
Tell, speak-to, message-to, explain-to and mention-to dominate over legislative office paths.
Send-iobj and send-to dominate alongside administration-ask; missing objects and speaker-versus-administration attachments remain case ambiguities.
Join/member/entry/membership/accession dominate with countries entering international institutions; join-person/action is excluded.
Return-to/leave-for/come-to/flee-to dominate, with geographic destinations; institution and theatrical destination senses remain boundaries.
Leader, majority leader and head/commander paths dominate, with person-to-legislature/command roles.
Leader and whip modifiers dominate. Nationality or party fragments remain unresolved institutional arguments; no founding or membership-only expansion.
Lawyer city-modifiers and lawyer-in dominate with private lawyers and geographic places; co-op/home/death rows are separate meanings.
Office-in, headquarters-in and based-in provide the largest coherent family (9 rows) versus move-to (6); person travel/residence is excluded.
Die-in/death-in/perish-in dominate, ordered deceased person/population to place; residence and locations of reports are distinct.
Coach possessive/nominal/at/for paths dominate; managerial office or branch-of-organization does not establish coaching.
Own, own-network, parent, acquire and subsidiary possessives dominate in owner-to-asset direction. Publisher/chair alone is insufficient.

Team/event modifiers, beaten-in-event and winning-title paths dominate with teams paired to World Series/Stanley Cup/Super Bowl. The common meaning is event participation; team-to-affiliate and coach-to-school are distinct.
Wife/widow-appositive, accompanied-by-wife and marital paths dominate, ordered spouse to named wife. Other people/places are not included.
Replace and succeed paths dominate with person-to-person office/coach succession roles. Replacement decision-maker versus actual successor remains ambiguous where no local role resolves it.
Director/direct/co-director paths are the largest specific office family; chairman, head and expert alone are excluded.
Director nominal/in/appointment/tenure paths dominate over chief and spokesman. Geographic modifiers require preserving omitted-institution ambiguity.
Explicit champion paths dominate with named sporting competitions or Olympic titles. Medalist/participation alone is not championship.
